svg.aria-label: 75 ms per token at batch 1 falls to 9.4 ms per token at batch 8; prefill is compute bound, decode is bandwidth bound
svg.text: The decode latency floor and batching amortization
Decode floor @70B fp16, batch 1: 150 GB / 2 TB/s = 75 ms/token
75 ms/token: the bandwidth law made concrete
Batch 8: same 75 ms step carries 8 tokens -> 9.4 ms/token
9.4 ms/token: why batching is the product
KV cache per token (70B GQA-8): 0.33 MB -> 1.3 GB at 4k, 10.5 GB at batch 8 x 4k.
Prefill is compute-bound (TTFT), decode is bandwidth-bound (tokens/sec): two regimes, two optimizations.
